meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
If your skin is **oily**, I’d prioritize a cleanser that removes excess sebum without leaving your face tight or squeaky. Salicylic acid is especially useful if you also have blackheads, clogged pores, or acne. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/beauty-and-grooming/best-salicylic-acid-face-washes-for-acne-prone-skin-in-monsoon-11662605?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My picks under ₹500

**🥇 Best overall: Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Cleanser — ~₹269.**  
Great choice if you're oily **and** get pimples, blackheads or clogged pores. Current listings put it comfortably under ₹500, and recent Indian skincare roundups specifically recommend it for oily/acne-prone skin. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/beauty-and-grooming/best-salicylic-acid-face-washes-for-acne-prone-skin-in-monsoon-11662605?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥈 If you have mild acne: The Derma Co 1% Salicylic Acid — ~₹215.**  
A slightly gentler salicylic-acid option.

**🥉 If you're oily but sensitive: Simple Refreshing Facial Wash — ~₹184–315.**  
Choose this instead of an acid cleanser if your skin gets irritated easily. It cleans without making acne treatment the focus.

**For oiliness without much acne: The Derma Co 2% Niacinamide Oily Skin Cleanser — ~₹269.**  
A reasonable option if your main problem is shine rather than clogged pores.

### What I'd buy
If you told me only **“oily skin, ₹500 budget”**, I'd buy the **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Cleanser**.

Use it **once daily initially**, particularly if you're new to salicylic acid. If you experience dryness, burning, or peeling, reduce frequency and switch to a gentle cleanser. Over-cleansing can irritate the skin barrier rather than improving oiliness.
